messages:
maya: FYI @jordan @kai — customer Epsilon LoRA merge on staging shows a quality regression after 4-bit quant in the quick eval pack. Rouge-L down ~6 pts on convo set.
jordan: ouch. which eval pack exactly? the convo-v2 customer set?
maya: yes — convo-v2 + kb-retrieval subset. quick-eval run id: 452. CI flagged 12 failing prompts, most are hallucination/slot errors when answers include concrete entity ids.
ci-bot: CI: quick-eval #452 - FAILED (regressions=12). Artifacts: s3://redwood-qa/quick-evals/452/logs.tar.gz · junit: s3://redwood-qa/quick-evals/452/results.xml
kai: can you paste the quant/merge command? did we apply any non-default quant recipe or swap-kv tweaks?
maya: we used the 4bit ptq recipe with swap-kv enabled. command run in staging merge job:
```
python tools/merge_lora.py --base model:v1.3 --lora epsilon-lora-v1 --out merged-epsilon-v1 --quant 4bit --quant-recipe ptq-e4m --swap-kv
```
serena: swap-kv + 4bit has caused subtle KV layout mismatches before (offsets). also check whether merged model's kv cache ordering differs.
raman: also confirm tokenizer/version alignment — if token ids shift it can look like hallucinations. was tokenizer.json changed?
maya: tokenizer not modified in the LoRA bundle. I dumped logits for a failed prompt and saw top-token ranking shift by 1 at positions after 64 tokens — looks like an off-by-one in KV indexing. pasted small snippet from logits diff (indices):
```
pos 65: ref=1123 pred=1124 (delta top1)
pos 66: ref=405 pred=405
```
jordan: good repro. next step: run the same merged model without quant to isolate. @ci-bot please queue quick-eval #453 with merged-epsilon-nq (no-quant) using same prompt set and seed.
ci-bot: Queued quick-eval #453 (merged-epsilon-nq). ETA ~12m.
kai: if #453 passes, rollback plan = disable quant for Epsilon in staging and prod, open issue for quant team to investigate swap-kv+ptq path. also add the 12 failing prompts to a targeted regression pack.
maya: will open GH issue with reproducible script + logs + s3 artifacts, and start rollback for staging -> pin to merged-epsilon-8bit. adding the failing prompts to the canary set now. :eyes:
serena: :thumbsup: we should also create a quick unit test that asserts KV alignment for merged models when swap-kv is set. low-effort and catches this earlier.
maya: agreed — filing the ticket and adding a follow-up task for test. I'll update thread when #453 finishes and when rollback is live.
